title: Late-Fee History Share — FlexLine Personal Lines of Credit
content:
**Tariff note.** The late fee on a FlexLine Personal Lines of Credit due date is scaled by a share that follows the late-fee entries already on the line in the last 12 months: none gives 0.80; exactly one gives 0.90; two or more give 1.00.

The share multiplies the late fee as figured, before the fee is held to no more than the unpaid part of the minimum payment and rounded to the cent.

*Counting.* The entries counted are the late-fee entries already on the line before the fee being booked. The last 12 months take the entries dated after the same day of the month 12 months before the booking date.

| Late-fee entries in the last 12 months | Share |
|---|---|
| none | 0.80 |
| exactly one | 0.90 |
| two or more | 1.00 |

*Hypothetical illustrations.* A fee figured at 12.50 USD on a line with no late-fee entry in the window becomes 10.00 USD at this share, before the cap and rounding. For a booking on 8 September, a late-fee entry dated 9 September of the year before is in the window; one dated 8 September of the year before is not.
